
```jsx
import { CxContainer } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxContainer from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/grid/CxContainer'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **fluid** | Set container 100% wide, spanning the entire width of the viewport. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **lg** | Set container 100% wide until large breakpoint. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **md** | Set container 100% wide until medium breakpoint. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **sm** | Set container 100% wide until small breakpoint. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **xl** | Set container 100% wide until X-large breakpoint. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **xxl** | Set container 100% wide until XX-large breakpoint. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
